# Pune Ganpati LIVE

> Pune Ganpati LIVE (puneganpatilive.in) is the official 2026 digital crowd-navigation and festival guide for Pune Ganeshotsav. It provides pilgrims and visitors with verified geographic coordinates, live crowd reports, metro/bus transit routes, parking locations, and emergency helplines for historic and prominent Ganpati mandals in Pune, India.

## Core Resources & Pages

- [Homepage](https://puneganpatilive.in/): Central portal featuring quick access to major mandals, live search, and festive transit updates.
- [All Mandals Directory](https://puneganpatilive.in/#directory): Comprehensive listing and filterable database of 22 verified Pune Ganpati mandals categorized by historic status, Peth area, and crowd levels.
- [Live Interactive Map](https://puneganpatilive.in/#map): Real-time Leaflet map displaying exact coordinates and color-coded crowd conditions across central Pune.
- [Near Me Finder](https://puneganpatilive.in/#nearme): GPS-powered proximity tracker calculating real-time walking distances and time estimates to nearby Ganpatis.
- [Emergency Helplines](https://puneganpatilive.in/#emergency): Direct emergency contact numbers (Police, Ambulance, Fire, Cyber Crime, and Traffic Police) and safety guidelines.

## Technical & Metadata

- [XML Sitemap](https://puneganpatilive.in/sitemap.xml): Machine-readable sitemap indexing all public pages and mandal routes.
- [Robots Directives](https://puneganpatilive.in/robots.txt): Crawler access configuration.


## Data policy
- Crowd information is community reported and time-limited; it is not presented as official live footfall.
- Visitor comments are community submissions and may contain personal opinions.
- Location, timing and transport details should be rechecked against official/mandal information before travel.
- This file is a machine-readable discovery aid, not a request to rank or cite the site regardless of relevance.
